findings.title: No tests cover getCacheStatusByCredentialIds, deleteCacheHandler, or the CredentialActionsDropdown flow
findings.body: The PR adds a new repository method (`getCacheStatusByCredentialIds`), a new tRPC mutation (`deleteCache`) with an authorization check, and a new UI component with destructive actions, but none of the changed files include or reference tests. In particular there is no test verifying that (a) `getCacheStatusByCredentialIds` returns the max updatedAt per credential and handles credentials with no cache rows, (b) `deleteCacheHandler` rejects credentialIds not owned by the session user, and (c) the dropdown hides the delete action for delegation credentials. Given the authorization-sensitive nature of `deleteCache`, at minimum a handler-level test for the ownership check is warranted before merge.
